name: TechBBQ 2023
description:
🔥 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐁𝐁𝐐 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟑 🔥


✨ Get ready for another round of the most hygge ‘tech & innovation’ summit in the Nordics! ✨


✨ Our yearly event brings together thousands of like-minded people and helps connect the Nordic and Baltic ecosystem with the rest of the world. Every September, we gather the tech community to help inspire and connect startups, entrepreneurs, tech talents, innovation enthusiasts, ecosystem builders, and investors looking for fresh opportunities. 


✨ Join us, once again, at Lokomotivværkstedet – our amazing venue in the heart of Copenhagen – for two fantastic days of tech & hygge! Don't miss out on talks about the latest tech trends by trendsetting and inspiring speakers, networking in a cozy and former locomotive workshop space, and a good old-fashioned BBQ in the garden! 


✨TechBBQ 2023 is an excellent opportunity to expand your mind and horizons. See you there!✨


𝐖𝐇𝐀𝐓 𝐓𝐎 𝐄𝐗𝐏𝐄𝐂𝐓:

💥 2 days jam-packed with an inspiring stage program, networking & showcasing

💥 6000+ attendees 

💥 Insightful keynote talks & panel discussions

💥 Garden sessions led by industry leaders

💥 Startup showcasing 

💥 Pitching competitions

💥 Access to afterparties 🥂

💥 Lots of 'hygge' vibes ✨

𝐔𝐒𝐄𝐅𝐔𝐋 𝐋𝐈𝐍𝐊𝐒:

🎟️  Ticket sales are now open: https://bit.ly/3CNwZ40

👉 Check out last year’s TechBBQ event: https://bit.ly/3QHq95P

💡 Learn more on our website: https://bit.ly/3GIEwCh


𝗔𝗕𝗢𝗨𝗧 𝗧𝗘𝗖𝗛𝗕𝗕𝗤 

TechBBQ is a non-profit organization created by the community for the community with the goal of supporting and accelerating the Nordic and Baltic tech startup ecosystems. We are the pulse of innovation and technology in the Nordics. 💫
